seoDescription: Buy genuine smartphones in Nepal: Android phones and iPhones from trusted brands, with cash on delivery and delivery across the country.
seoContent:
## Buy smartphones in Nepal

Choosing a new phone comes down to how you use it: the camera you want, how long the battery needs to last, how much storage your photos and apps take, and how long you plan to keep it. Our phones section brings together Android phones and iPhones so you can compare them in one place.

## How to choose a phone

- Storage: 128 GB is a comfortable minimum today; choose 256 GB or more if you shoot a lot of video
- RAM: 8 GB or more keeps Android phones smooth for years of app updates
- Battery and charging: look at battery capacity and the supported charging speed, and use a charger that matches it
- Camera: compare the main sensor, ultra-wide and zoom options rather than megapixels alone
- Software support: brands differ in how many years of Android or iOS updates a model receives

## Phone registration in Nepal

Phones used in Nepal need their IMEI registered with the Nepal Telecommunications Authority's Mobile Device Management System (MDMS), otherwise a SIM may stop working in them. If you have a question about a particular model, contact us before you order.

faqs.question: Should I buy an Android phone or an iPhone?
faqs.answer: iPhones give you long software support, tight integration with other Apple devices and strong resale value. Android phones offer far more choice in price, design and features such as expandable storage or very fast charging. If you already use a Mac, iPad or Apple Watch, an iPhone fits in easily; otherwise Android gives you more options at every budget.

faqs.question: What is MDMS registration and does it affect me?
faqs.answer: MDMS is the Nepal Telecommunications Authority's system for registering phone IMEI numbers. Phones whose IMEI is not registered can be blocked from Nepali mobile networks. Ask us about a specific model if you want to confirm before buying.

faqs.question: Does the phone come with a charger in the box?
faqs.answer: It depends on the brand and model. Many recent phones, including iPhones, ship with only a cable. The product page lists what is included; if a charger is not in the box, see our chargers section for a compatible fast charger.

faqs.question: Can I pay for a phone with cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cash on delivery is available for phones, as is payment with eSewa.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Android phones in Nepal from Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus and more. Compare models, pay on delivery, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy Android phones in Nepal

Android phones cover every budget, from dependable everyday phones to flagships with some of the best cameras and displays available. That range is the main reason most Nepali buyers choose Android: you can pick exactly the features you care about.

## What to look for in an Android phone

- Processor: Snapdragon, Dimensity and Exynos chips vary a lot; a recent mid-range chip is plenty for social media, streaming and casual gaming
- RAM and storage: 8 GB RAM and 128 GB storage is a sensible starting point; check whether the model has a microSD slot
- Display: AMOLED panels give deeper blacks, and a 90 Hz or 120 Hz refresh rate makes scrolling smoother
- Battery: 5000 mAh is common and lasts a full day for most people; compare charging speeds too
- Updates: some brands now promise several years of Android and security updates, which keeps a phone safer for longer

All Android phones at 361 Gadgets are genuine retail units. Check the product page for the exact variant, colour and what is in the box.

faqs.question: How much RAM do I need in an Android phone?
faqs.answer: For everyday use, 6 to 8 GB is comfortable. If you play demanding games, keep many apps open or want the phone to stay quick for several years, 12 GB gives you more headroom.

faqs.question: Do Android phones support dual SIM in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Most Android phones support two SIM cards, either as two physical SIMs or one physical SIM plus eSIM. The product page lists the SIM configuration for each model.

faqs.question: Is fast charging safe for the battery?
faqs.answer: Yes, when you use the charger designed for the phone or a certified charger that supports the same standard. Phones manage charging speed and temperature themselves. Cheap uncertified chargers are the real risk.

faqs.question: Can I return an Android phone if I change my mind?
faqs.answer: Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused, undamaged and in their original sealed packaging. Once a phone has been activated and used it may not be eligible.

seoDescription: Buy genuine iPhones in Nepal at 361 Gadgets. Original Apple iPhones with cash on delivery or eSewa, delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy iPhones in Nepal

The iPhone is popular for good reasons: years of iOS updates, excellent video recording, strong privacy features and a resale value that holds up well. At 361 Gadgets we sell genuine Apple iPhones, so you know exactly what you are getting.

## Choosing the right iPhone

- Standard vs Pro: Pro models add a telephoto camera, a brighter ProMotion display and more advanced video features
- Storage: iPhones have no memory card slot, so choose storage carefully; 128 GB suits light users, 256 GB or more suits people who record video
- Size: the Plus and Pro Max models have bigger screens and the longest battery life
- Ecosystem: AirDrop, iCloud, Apple Watch and AirPods all work best together

## Buying an iPhone safely

In Nepal it is worth confirming that a phone is genuine and that its IMEI can be registered with the NTA's MDMS system. Our iPhones are original Apple units. The product page lists the model, storage, colour and what comes in the box.

faqs.question: Are your iPhones original Apple products?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every iPhone we sell is a genuine Apple device. We do not sell copies or refurbished units presented as new.

faqs.question: Does the iPhone come with a charger?
faqs.answer: Recent iPhones come with a USB-C cable but no power adapter. For fast charging, use a USB-C Power Delivery charger of 20 W or more, which you will find in our chargers section.

faqs.question: How much storage should I choose for an iPhone?
faqs.answer: iPhones cannot take a memory card, so buy the storage you will need for the life of the phone. 128 GB works for most people who use iCloud; choose 256 GB or 512 GB if you record a lot of 4K video or keep large offline libraries.

faqs.question: Will an iPhone work on Nepali networks?
faqs.answer: Yes, iPhones work on Nepal Telecom and Ncell networks, including 4G. The IMEI needs to be registered with the NTA's MDMS system, as with any phone used in Nepal.

seoDescription: Shop genuine tablets in Nepal: Apple iPads and Android tablets for study, work and entertainment, delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy tablets in Nepal

A tablet sits between a phone and a laptop: big enough for comfortable reading, video calls, online classes and drawing, yet light enough to carry everywhere. We stock Apple iPads and Android tablets so you can choose the platform that suits you.

## How to choose a tablet

- Use: streaming and reading need little power; drawing, note-taking and editing benefit from a faster chip and stylus support
- Screen: 10 to 11 inches suits most people; larger screens are better for multitasking and drawing
- Storage: 64 GB fills up quickly with apps and offline video, so 128 GB is a safer choice
- Connectivity: Wi-Fi models are cheaper; cellular models let you use a SIM away from Wi-Fi
- Accessories: check keyboard and stylus compatibility before you buy

Browse iPads and Android tablets below, or open a product to see its full specifications.

faqs.question: Is a tablet good for online classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. A tablet with a good front camera, stereo speakers and at least 4 GB of RAM handles Zoom, Google Meet and Teams well. Add a keyboard case if you type a lot.

faqs.question: Should I choose an iPad or an Android tablet?
faqs.answer: iPads have excellent apps for study, drawing and productivity and receive long software support. Android tablets cost less for a similar screen size and work well with Google services and Android phones.

faqs.question: Can I use a SIM card in a tablet?
faqs.answer: Only in models labelled cellular, LTE or 5G. Wi-Fi-only models connect through Wi-Fi or a phone hotspot.

seoDescription: Buy genuine Android tablets in Nepal from Samsung, Xiaomi, Lenovo and more, ideal for study, streaming and work. Cash on delivery available.
seoContent:
## Buy Android tablets in Nepal

Android tablets give you a big, comfortable screen for YouTube, Netflix, reading, online classes and video calls, often for much less than a laptop. Many now support a stylus and keyboard covers, which makes them useful for note-taking and light work as well.

## What to look for

- Display: an 11-inch screen with a resolution above Full HD keeps text sharp; 90 Hz or higher feels smoother
- RAM: 4 GB is fine for streaming; 6 to 8 GB is better for multitasking and split-screen apps
- Storage: 128 GB, or a model with a microSD slot so you can add more
- Battery: tablets with 7000 mAh or more last a full day of classes or a long journey
- Speakers: quad speakers make a real difference for movies and calls
- Stylus: check whether a pen is included or sold separately

All Android tablets we sell are genuine. Specifications and what is in the box are listed on each product page.

faqs.question: Which Android tablet is best for students?
faqs.answer: Look for at least 4 GB of RAM, 64 to 128 GB of storage, a good front camera for online classes and long battery life. Stylus support is a bonus if you like handwritten notes.

faqs.question: Can I add storage to an Android tablet?
faqs.answer: Many Android tablets have a microSD card slot. Check the product specifications; if it has one, a fast microSD card from our memory cards section is an easy upgrade.

faqs.question: Do Android tablets get software updates?
faqs.answer: Yes, but how long depends on the brand. Some manufacturers promise several years of Android and security updates for their tablets, so it is worth comparing before you buy.

seoDescription: Buy genuine Apple iPads in Nepal at 361 Gadgets: iPad, iPad Air, iPad mini and iPad Pro, with cash on delivery and nationwide delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy iPads in Nepal

The iPad is the tablet most people compare everything else against. It is fast, has the best selection of tablet apps and works with the Apple Pencil and keyboard covers, so it can be a sketchbook, a notebook, a TV and a work device in one.

## Which iPad is right for you

- iPad: the everyday choice for streaming, reading, browsing and school work
- iPad mini: small enough to hold in one hand, great for reading and travel
- iPad Air: a faster chip and support for more accessories, ideal for students and creators
- iPad Pro: the most powerful iPad, with the best display, for professional drawing, photo and video work

## Before you buy

Check which Apple Pencil and keyboard models work with the iPad you choose, as compatibility varies between generations. Decide on storage up front too, because iPads cannot be upgraded later. Every iPad at 361 Gadgets is a genuine Apple product.

faqs.question: Which Apple Pencil works with my iPad?
faqs.answer: It depends on the iPad model and generation. Each product page lists the compatible Apple Pencil; if you are unsure, contact us with your iPad model before ordering an accessory.

faqs.question: Is an iPad good for drawing?
faqs.answer: Yes. With an Apple Pencil and apps such as Procreate, an iPad is one of the most popular digital drawing tools. The iPad Air and iPad Pro have the best screens and the lowest pen latency.

faqs.question: Should I get a Wi-Fi or cellular iPad?
faqs.answer: A Wi-Fi iPad is enough if you mostly use it at home, college or with your phone's hotspot. Choose a cellular model if you want mobile data on the iPad itself.

faqs.question: How much storage do I need on an iPad?
faqs.answer: 64 GB is tight once you install apps and download videos. 128 GB or 256 GB is a better choice for students and creators, since storage cannot be added later.

seoDescription: Shop genuine earbuds, headphones, neckbands and earphones in Nepal. Original audio gear from trusted brands, delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy earbuds and headphones in Nepal

Good audio makes a daily commute, a workout or a long day of calls far more pleasant. Our audio section covers every style: true wireless earbuds, neckband earphones, wired earphones and over-ear or on-ear headphones.

## Picking the right style

- TWS earbuds: completely wireless and pocketable, with a charging case
- Neckbands: wireless with a band around the neck, long battery life and less risk of losing an earbud
- Wired earphones: no charging, no lag, and the best value for sound quality
- Headphones: the most comfortable for long sessions and usually the best sound and noise cancellation

## Features worth comparing

- Active noise cancellation (ANC) for traffic, buses and flights
- Battery life of the earbuds and the case together
- Microphone quality for calls and online meetings
- Codec support such as AAC or LDAC for better wireless sound
- Water resistance (IPX4 or higher) for workouts and rain

All audio products we sell are genuine, so the sound and battery life match what the brand advertises.

faqs.question: What is the difference between TWS earbuds and neckbands?
faqs.answer: TWS earbuds are fully wireless and charge in a case, making them very compact. Neckbands connect the two earpieces with a band that sits around your neck, which usually gives longer battery life and makes them harder to lose.

faqs.question: Is noise cancellation worth it?
faqs.answer: If you travel on buses, work in a noisy place or fly often, yes. Active noise cancellation reduces constant background noise so you can listen at a lower, safer volume.

faqs.question: Will these earbuds work with both Android and iPhone?
faqs.answer: Bluetooth earbuds and headphones work with both. Some features, such as companion apps or special codecs, may work best on one platform; the product page mentions this where it matters.

faqs.question: Can I return earbuds after opening them?
faqs.answer: For hygiene reasons, opened or used in-ear products may not be eligible for return. Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 7 days of delivery.

seoDescription: Buy genuine TWS earbuds in Nepal: true wireless earbuds with ANC, long battery life and clear calls. Original brands, cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy TWS earbuds in Nepal

True wireless (TWS) earbuds have become the default way to listen on the go. There are no wires at all: the earbuds connect over Bluetooth and recharge in a pocket-sized case. The difference between a cheap pair and a good one shows up in sound, call quality, battery life and connection stability.

## How to choose TWS earbuds

- Fit: earbuds with several ear-tip sizes seal better, which improves bass and noise cancellation
- ANC: active noise cancellation cuts traffic and engine noise; transparency mode lets you hear announcements
- Battery: compare earbud battery life and total life with the case; 6 hours per charge is a good benchmark
- Calls: multiple microphones with noise reduction make calls clearer in busy streets
- Latency: a low-latency or game mode helps with videos and mobile games
- Water resistance: IPX4 or higher for workouts and rain
- Bluetooth version: 5.3 and newer connect faster and hold the connection better

Our TWS earbuds are genuine products from established audio brands. Specifications, battery figures and what is in the box are on each product page.

faqs.question: How long do TWS earbuds last on a charge?
faqs.answer: Most earbuds last 5 to 8 hours per charge, and the case adds another two to four full charges. Using ANC or high volume shortens battery life; each product page lists the brand's figures.

faqs.question: Are TWS earbuds good for phone calls?
faqs.answer: Good ones are. Look for models with multiple microphones and call noise reduction. Budget earbuds often sound fine for music but pick up a lot of background noise on calls.

faqs.question: Can I use TWS earbuds for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes, but choose a model with a low-latency or game mode. Standard Bluetooth adds a small delay that you may notice in fast mobile games.

faqs.question: How do I know my earbuds are genuine?
faqs.answer: Buy from a trusted seller. Copies of popular earbuds are common in Nepal and often have poor sound, weak batteries and no real noise cancellation. Every pair at 361 Gadgets is a genuine product.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Bluetooth neckband earphones in Nepal with long battery life, fast charging and clear calls. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy neckband earphones in Nepal

Neckband earphones are a practical choice for people who wear earphones all day. The band rests around your neck, so when you take the earbuds out they simply hang there instead of going into a case or getting lost. The larger body also holds a bigger battery than most true wireless earbuds.

## Why choose a neckband

- Long battery life, often 20 hours or more on one charge
- Fast charging: many give several hours of playback from a 10-minute charge
- Magnetic earbuds that clip together and can pause music
- Hard to lose, which makes them good for commuting, running and riding
- Physical buttons for volume, calls and tracks

## What to compare

Look at battery life, charging port (USB-C is the most convenient), water resistance for workouts and whether the model supports connecting to two devices at once. All neckbands we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Are neckbands better than TWS earbuds?
faqs.answer: They suit different people. Neckbands usually have longer battery life, physical buttons and are hard to lose. TWS earbuds are smaller and fit in a pocket. If you wear earphones for most of the day, a neckband is often more practical.

faqs.question: Can I use a neckband while running or riding?
faqs.answer: Yes. The band keeps the earphones secure, and many models are sweat resistant. On a bike or scooter, keep the volume low so you can still hear traffic.

faqs.question: How long does a neckband take to charge?
faqs.answer: Most charge fully in one to two hours, and many support quick charging that gives several hours of music from about 10 minutes. Check the product page for each model's figures.

seoDescription: Buy genuine wired earphones in Nepal: USB-C, Lightning and 3.5 mm earphones with mic for clear calls and great sound value.
seoContent:
## Buy wired earphones in Nepal

Wired earphones are still the best value in audio. They never need charging, have no Bluetooth delay and usually sound better than wireless earbuds at the same price. They are also handy as a dependable backup for calls and online classes.

## Choose the right connector

- 3.5 mm jack: works with laptops, older phones, tablets and many gaming controllers
- USB-C: for recent Android phones and iPhone 15 or newer models without a headphone jack
- Lightning: for iPhone models from the iPhone 7 up to the iPhone 14 series

## What else to look for

- An inline microphone and remote for calls and music control
- A tangle-resistant or braided cable that lasts longer
- Comfortable ear tips in several sizes

All wired earphones at 361 Gadgets are genuine, with the connector type listed clearly on each product page.

faqs.question: Will USB-C earphones work with every USB-C phone?
faqs.answer: Most recent phones support USB-C audio, but a few older models do not. If your phone came without a headphone jack and supports USB-C audio adapters, USB-C earphones will work.

faqs.question: Are wired earphones better for gaming?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wired earphones have no wireless delay, so sound stays in sync with what is on screen, which matters in fast mobile and PC games.

faqs.question: Do wired earphones work for online classes and calls?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as they have an inline microphone. Most models listed here include a mic; check the product page to confirm.

seoDescription: Shop genuine wireless and wired headphones in Nepal, with noise cancellation and long battery life. Original brands, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy headphones in Nepal

Headphones are the most comfortable way to listen for hours at a time. Over-ear and on-ear designs have bigger drivers than earbuds, which means fuller sound, and the best wireless models block out noise remarkably well.

## Over-ear vs on-ear

- Over-ear headphones surround your ears, isolate noise better and are the most comfortable for long sessions
- On-ear headphones are smaller and lighter, and fold away more easily for travel

## Features to compare

- Active noise cancellation for flights, buses and open offices
- Battery life: 30 hours or more is common on good wireless models
- Multipoint pairing to switch between laptop and phone
- A wired option (3.5 mm) for when the battery runs out
- Comfort: weight, clamping force and ear-cushion material all matter on long days

Whether you need headphones for music, study, work calls or travel, every pair we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: Are noise-cancelling headphones good for studying?
faqs.answer: Yes. Active noise cancellation reduces constant noise such as traffic, generators and chatter, which helps you concentrate without turning the volume up.

faqs.question: Can I use wireless headphones with a cable?
faqs.answer: Many wireless headphones include a 3.5 mm cable so you can keep listening when the battery is flat or connect to a device without Bluetooth. The product page lists what is included.

faqs.question: Are headphones better than earbuds for long use?
faqs.answer: For many people, yes. Headphones do not sit inside the ear canal, so they can be more comfortable over several hours, and they usually offer longer battery life.

seoDescription: Buy genuine mobile accessories in Nepal: chargers, cables, power banks, cases and screen protectors from trusted brands.
seoContent:
## Buy mobile accessories in Nepal

The right accessories protect your phone and keep it charged wherever you are. Poor-quality chargers, cables and power banks are one of the most common causes of battery damage, so genuine accessories are worth it.

## Our mobile accessories

- Chargers: fast wall chargers with USB-C Power Delivery and Quick Charge support
- Cables: USB-C, Lightning and micro-USB cables in different lengths
- Power banks: portable batteries for travel, trekking and power cuts
- Cases: protective covers that keep your phone safe from drops
- Screen protectors: tempered glass to prevent scratches and cracks

## Get the right fit

Cases and screen protectors are made for specific models, so check the compatible phones listed on the product page. For chargers and cables, match the connector and the fast-charging standard your phone supports.

faqs.question: Will a fast charger damage my phone?
faqs.answer: No. A certified fast charger only delivers the power your phone asks for. Problems come from cheap, uncertified chargers that do not regulate voltage properly.

faqs.question: How do I find a case or screen protector for my phone?
faqs.answer: Each case and screen protector lists the exact phone models it fits. Match your phone model exactly, because similar names, such as Pro and Pro Max, have different sizes.

faqs.question: Do you deliver accessories across Nepal?
faqs.answer: Yes, we deliver to all 77 districts, with cash on delivery or eSewa payment.

seoDescription: Shop genuine charging and data cables in Nepal: USB-C, Lightning and micro-USB cables that support fast charging. Delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy charging cables in Nepal

A cable looks simple, but it decides how fast your phone charges and how long it lasts. Cheap cables can fail to support fast charging, break at the connector after a few weeks or overheat. A good cable is one of the smallest upgrades that makes a real difference every day.

## How to choose a cable

- Connector: USB-C to USB-C for modern Android phones, laptops and iPhone 15 or newer; USB-C to Lightning for older iPhones; micro-USB for older devices
- Power rating: 60 W cables cover phones and tablets, 100 W or 240 W cables can also charge laptops
- Data speed: if you transfer files, check the USB speed, not only the charging power
- Length: 1 metre for daily use, 2 metres for charging in bed or in a car
- Build: braided cables and reinforced connectors last much longer

Every cable we sell is genuine and lists its connector, length and power rating on the product page.

faqs.question: Does the cable affect charging speed?
faqs.answer: Yes. A phone only fast-charges when the charger, the cable and the phone all support the same standard and power level. A low-rated cable can limit the speed even with a fast charger.

faqs.question: Can I charge my laptop with a USB-C cable?
faqs.answer: If your laptop charges over USB-C, yes, but use a cable rated for 100 W or more and a charger with enough power. Phone cables rated at 60 W may charge a laptop slowly.

faqs.question: Which cable do I need for my iPhone?
faqs.answer: iPhone 15 and newer use USB-C. iPhones from the iPhone 5 to the iPhone 14 series use Lightning. For fast charging, use a USB-C to Lightning cable with a USB-C Power Delivery charger.

seoDescription: Buy phone cases in Nepal: protective, slim and shockproof covers for iPhone, Samsung and other phones. Genuine, delivered nationwide.
seoContent:
## Buy phone cases in Nepal

A case is the cheapest insurance for your phone. Screen and back-glass repairs are expensive, and a good case absorbs the impact of everyday drops while keeping the phone looking new.

## Types of phone cases

- Slim cases: thin and light, protect against scratches and minor drops
- Shockproof cases: reinforced corners and raised edges for better drop protection
- Clear cases: show off the phone's colour; quality ones resist yellowing
- MagSafe-compatible cases: built-in magnets for iPhone chargers, wallets and mounts

## What to check

- The exact phone model it fits
- Raised edges around the screen and camera lenses
- Button feel and cut-outs for ports and speakers
- Compatibility with wireless charging and MagSafe if you use them

All cases at 361 Gadgets are genuine and list compatible phone models on the product page.

faqs.question: Will the case fit my phone?
faqs.answer: Cases are made for specific models. Check the compatible models on the product page and match your phone exactly, as Pro, Plus and Max versions have different sizes and camera layouts.

faqs.question: Can I wirelessly charge with a case on?
faqs.answer: Most slim and standard cases work with wireless charging. Very thick cases or cases with metal parts can block it. MagSafe-compatible cases keep magnetic chargers aligned on iPhones.

faqs.question: Do clear cases turn yellow?
faqs.answer: Cheap clear cases yellow quickly with sunlight and handling. Quality clear cases use anti-yellowing materials that stay clear much longer.

seoDescription: Shop genuine fast chargers in Nepal: USB-C PD, GaN and multi-port wall chargers for phones, tablets and laptops. Cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy fast chargers in Nepal

A good charger saves time and protects your battery. Many new phones ship without one, and fake chargers are common, so a genuine charger from a trusted brand is worth buying.

## How to choose a charger

- Standard: USB-C Power Delivery (PD) works with iPhones, most Android phones, iPads and many laptops; some brands also use their own fast-charging standards
- Wattage: 20 W suits iPhones, 25 to 45 W suits most Android phones, 65 W or more can charge laptops
- GaN technology: smaller, cooler chargers that deliver high power
- Ports: multi-port chargers can charge a phone, earbuds and a laptop from one socket
- Safety: protection against overheating, over-current and voltage spikes matters with Nepal's power fluctuations

All chargers we sell are genuine. The product page lists supported standards, wattage per port and the plug type.

faqs.question: What charger do I need for fast charging my iPhone?
faqs.answer: Any USB-C Power Delivery charger rated at 20 W or more fast-charges recent iPhones. Pair it with a USB-C to Lightning cable for older iPhones or a USB-C cable for iPhone 15 and newer.

faqs.question: Can one charger charge my phone and laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, if the laptop charges over USB-C. A 65 W or higher multi-port GaN charger can charge a laptop and a phone at the same time. Check that the wattage per port is enough for your laptop.

faqs.question: Are cheap chargers dangerous?
faqs.answer: Uncertified chargers can overheat, deliver unstable voltage and damage batteries. Genuine chargers include protection circuits that make them much safer.

faqs.question: Will the plug fit sockets in Nepal?
faqs.answer: The plug type is listed on each product page. If a charger has a different plug, use a good-quality travel adapter from our tech accessories section.

seoDescription: Buy genuine power banks in Nepal: 10000 mAh to 20000 mAh+ portable chargers with fast charging, for travel, treks and power cuts.
seoContent:
## Buy power banks in Nepal

A power bank keeps your phone alive on long bus journeys, treks, trips outside the valley and during power cuts. Capacity and charging speed matter, but so does safety: a genuine power bank has proper battery cells and protection circuits.

## How to choose a power bank

- Capacity: 10000 mAh charges most phones about twice and fits in a pocket; 20000 mAh suits travel and tablets
- Real output: some capacity is lost in conversion, so expect roughly 60 to 70 percent of the rated mAh to reach your phone
- Fast charging: USB-C Power Delivery for iPhones and most phones, and higher wattage if you want to charge a laptop
- Ports: USB-C input and output charges faster and works both ways
- Size and weight: slimmer models are easier to carry every day

## Flying with a power bank

Airlines generally allow power banks in cabin baggage only, with limits on capacity. Power banks up to 100 Wh (about 27000 mAh at 3.7 V) are usually accepted, but check your airline's rules before flying.

faqs.question: How many times will a 10000 mAh power bank charge my phone?
faqs.answer: Usually about twice for a phone with a 4000 to 5000 mAh battery, because some energy is lost during charging. Larger phone batteries get fewer full charges.

faqs.question: Can I take a power bank on a flight from Nepal?
faqs.answer: Power banks must go in hand luggage, not checked bags. Most airlines allow power banks up to 100 Wh without approval. Check the capacity in Wh on the power bank and your airline's rules before you travel.

faqs.question: Can a power bank charge a laptop?
faqs.answer: Only if it supports USB-C Power Delivery at a high enough wattage, usually 45 W to 100 W, and your laptop charges over USB-C.

faqs.question: How do I make my power bank last longer?
faqs.answer: Avoid leaving it in hot places, recharge it every few months even when unused, and use a good cable and charger. Genuine power banks with quality cells keep their capacity much longer.

seoContent:
## Buy screen protectors in Nepal

Replacing a phone screen costs far more than protecting it. A tempered glass screen protector takes the scratches and the impact of drops so your actual display stays intact.

## Types of screen protectors

- Tempered glass: hard (often rated 9H), smooth to touch and clear; the most popular choice
- Full coverage: covers the whole front including curved edges
- Privacy glass: darkens the screen when viewed from the side, useful in buses and offices
- Matte glass: reduces glare and fingerprints, good for gaming

## Fitting tips

- Choose the protector made for your exact phone model
- Clean the screen with the included wipes and remove dust with the sticker before applying
- Use the alignment frame if one is included
- Small bubbles at the edge usually disappear within a day

All screen protectors at 361 Gadgets are genuine and list the compatible phone models.

faqs.question: What does 9H hardness mean?
faqs.answer: 9H refers to a pencil hardness test, meaning the glass resists scratches from everyday objects such as keys and coins. It does not make the glass unbreakable, but a protector that cracks has done its job by saving your screen.

faqs.question: Will a screen protector affect the fingerprint sensor?
faqs.answer: Protectors made for your model are designed to work with its fingerprint sensor and face unlock. After fitting, re-registering your fingerprint can improve recognition.

faqs.question: Do I need a screen protector if my phone has strong glass?
faqs.answer: Even strengthened glass scratches and cracks. A protector is a cheap layer that is easy to replace, while a new display is expensive.
